description: This source file contains unit tests for the HTML format generator component of the Daux documentation project. It verifies the generation of documentation pages, including navigation, analytics, sidebar links, landing pages, and raw pages, using PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: GeneratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the HTML page generation capabilities of the Daux documentation generator, focusing on single pages, analytics integration, search functionality, sidebar links, landing pages, and raw content handling.

methods.name: getDaux
methods.description: Sets up a virtual filesystem with sample markdown and SVG files, configures Daux with provided options, and generates the documentation tree for testing.

methods.name: testGenerateSinglePage
methods.description: Tests the generation of a single documentation page and verifies the presence of pagination, breadcrumb, search, and navigation elements.

methods.name: testGenerateAnalytics
methods.description: Tests that analytics scripts (Google Analytics, Piwik, Plausible) are correctly embedded in generated pages based on configuration.

methods.name: testGenerateSinglePageWithoutSearch
methods.description: Verifies that search elements are excluded when the search feature is disabled in configuration.

methods.name: testGenerateSidebarLinks
methods.description: Checks that custom sidebar links, including social and external links, are correctly included in the generated page.

methods.name: testGenerateLandingPage
methods.description: Tests generating a landing page with custom buttons and links, ensuring content is correctly rendered.

methods.name: testGenerateRawPage
methods.description: Verifies that raw files like SVG are correctly served as content without processing.
